script_text: Your texts are glitching, contracts are collapsing, and an ex just texted you suddenly — welcome to Mercury Retrograde. Mercury Retrograde occurs when swift Mercury, ruler of the Air element, appears to reverse course across the sky. Mercury backtracks through the zodiac, scrambling messages, travel, and technology. Watch for crossed wires in your 3rd House of communication, stalled negotiations in your 7th House of relationships, and reputation hiccups in your 10th House of career. Mercury squares Saturn, freezing financial deals, while conjunct Venus in your 5th House, an old flame returns. This Retrograde is a karmic audit, not a punishment, urging you to square old wounds with Chiron and return to your North Node path. What dissolves now was never aligned with your soul’s true direction. Do not sign contracts or launch major projects until Mercury stations direct. Comment your sign and what Mercury is forcing you to revisit.
